_comment: Extracted from an ES-DE Android config export (custom_systems). Source XML was deleted after extraction; regenerate only from a fresh device pull. Emulators are listed in ES-DE preference order; the first entry is the default.

device_export.note: es_systems.xml from the device is the custom_systems override file (ROM-hack and modern-console systems), NOT ES-DE's full system list. es_find_rules.xml is Android package names only and has no value off Android. es_settings.xml sets AlternativeEmulatorPerGame=true, so per-game emulator overrides live in the gamelist.xml files, which were not exported.

bundled.note: Upstream ES-DE defaults; identical for every user.

default_core_source._comment: Defaults come from the Android ES-DE export first — that device is known to work, so its choices win. Platforms the export never covered fall back to community consensus (libretro docs / ES-DE defaults) and are listed under community_consensus so the two are never confused.

no_libretro_core.ps2: LRPS2 has no usable macOS build; PCSX2 is standalone
no_libretro_core.ps3: RPCS3 is standalone, no libretro core
no_libretro_core.new-nintendo-3ds: Citra cores are unmaintained and absent for macOS arm64
